Mary, mother of Jesus: Bikira Mariya Mweranda, Nyina w'Imana na Nyina wa Ekleziya, yatoranyijwe kuva kera kose ngo avyare Umukiza. Yasamwe nta caha kandi ni isugi iteka; yajanywe mu ijuru n'umubiri na roho.
Our Lady of Guadalupe: Mu 1531 Bikira Mweranda yabonekeye Mweranda Juan Diego ku musozi wa Tepeyac hafi y'umuji wa Mexico, asiga ishusho ye ku mwitero we. Ni Umurinzi wa Amerika.
Our Lady of Fátima: Mu 1917 Bikira Mweranda yabonekeye abana batatu b'abashumba i Fatima muri Portugal, ahamagarira isi gusenga, kwicuza, kuvuga Rozari buri munsi no kwiyegurira Umutima we Utagira inenge.
Our Lady of Lourdes: Mu 1858 Bikira Mweranda yabonekeye Mweranda Bernadeta inshuro cumi n'umunani i Lourdes mu Bufaransa, avuga ati: "Ndi Uwasamwe Atagira Icaha." Isoko ye yabaye ahantu ho gukirira no gutagatifuzwa kuva ico gihe.
Our Lady of Aparecida: Mu 1717 abarovyi bakuye mu ruzi rwa Paraíba ishusho nto y'Uwasamwe Atagira Icaha, maze inshundura zabo zari zirimo ubusa ziruzura. Bikira Mariya Aparecida ni Umwamikazi n'Umurinzi wa Brezile.
Our Mother of Perpetual Help: Ishusho ntagatifu ya kera igaragaza Umwana Yezu yiruka asanga Nyina amaze kubona ibikoresho vy'Ububabare bwiwe. Muhire Piyo IX yayishinze Abaredemptoristi mu 1866 ngo bayimenyekanishe ku isi yose.
Our Lady of the Pillar: Uruhererekane ruvuga ko Bikira Mweranda yaje gusanga Mweranda Yakobo Intumwa i Zaragoza kugira ngo akomeze ivugabutumwa rye muri Esipanye, asiga inkingi nk'ikimenyetso. Ni Umurinzi wa Esipanye n'abavuga icesipanyoli.
Our Lady of Mount Carmel: Mariya nk'Umuvyeyi n'Umurinzi w'Umuryango w'Abakarumeli. Yahaye Mweranda Simoni Stock Ishapule y'ikigina nk'ikimenyetso c'uburinzi bwiwe ku bayambara bose bafite ukwemera.
Our Lady of the Rosary: Uyu munsi mukuru wibutsa intsinzi ya Lepanto mu 1571, yabonetse abakristu bavuga Rozari. Udutumira kuzirikana amayobera ya Kristu turi kumwe na Nyina.
Our Lady of Sorrows: Uhimbaza uruhare rwa Mama Mweranda mu Bubabare bw'Umwana we binyuze mu bubabare bwiwe burindwi, kuva ku buhanuzi bwa Simewoni kugeza Yezu ahambwa. Yahagaze ashikamye munsi y'Umusaraba.
Immaculate Conception: Ku bw'ingabire idasanzwe y'Imana, Bikira Mariya Mweranda yarinzwe icaha c'inkomoko kuva ku isegonda rya mbere asamwa. Ni umunsi mukuru w'umurinzi wa Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika.
Assumption of Mary: Arangije ubuzima bwiwe bwo ku isi, Bikira Mariya Mweranda yajanywe n'umubiri na roho mu ikuzo ry'ijuru, nk'uko Papa Piyo XII yavyemeje ku mugaragaro mu 1950.
Sacred Heart: Ku wa Gatanu nyuma y'Icumweru ca kabiri nyuma ya Pentekosti
Kwiyegurira Umutima Mweranda wa Yezu bihimbaza urukundo rwe rugurumana akunda abantu. Umwami yahishuriye Mweranda Margarita Mariya Alakoki amasezerano yawo mu myaka ya 1670.
Holy Family: Yezu, Mariya na Yozefu mu rugo rwabo i Nazareti, urugero ku muryango wose w'abakristu mu kwemera, urukundo no kumvira Imana.
Trinity: Iyobera nyamukuru ry'ukwemera kwacu: Imana imwe mu Bantu batatu b'Imana, Data, Mwana na Roho Mweranda.
Holy Spirit in Christianity: Umuntu wa gatatu w'Ubutatu Butagatifu, Umwami utanga ubuzima, wamanukiye Intumwa kuri Pentekosti kandi utagatifuza Ekleziya.
Christ the King: Icumweru ca nyuma c'umwaka wa liturujiya
Papa Piyo XI yashyizeho uyu munsi mukuru mu 1925 kugira ngo yamamaze ingoma ya Yezu Kristu mu mitima yose, mu miryango no mu bihugu vyose.
Divine Mercy: Kwiyegurira urukundo rw'impuhwe z'Imana rwahishuriwe Mweranda Fawustina Kowalska, ruvunagurwa mu isengesho "Yezu, ndakwizera." Mweranda Yohani Pawulo II yashyizeho Icumweru c'Impuhwe z'Imana mu 2000.
Santo Niño de Cebú: Ishusho y'Umwana Yezu Mweranda yatanzwe igihe umwamikazi w'i Cebu yabatizwaga mu 1521, ishusho ya gikristu ya kera kurusha izindi muri Filipine.
Juan Diego: Mweranda Juan Diego Cuauhtlatoatzin, kavukire wicisha bugufi wayobotse ukwemera, wabonekewe na Bikira Mariya w'i Guadalupe mu 1531. Mweranda Yohani Pawulo II yamushyize mu beeranda mu 2002.
Kateri Tekakwitha: "Irebe ry'Abamohawk" (1656–1680), umukobwa wayobotse ukwemera, w'isugi kandi usenga cane, mweranda wa mbere w'abakavukire muri Amerika y'Amajaruguru.
Martin de Porres: Umufurere w'Umudominikani w'i Lima muri Peru (1579–1639), wamenyekanye kubera kwita yicishije bugufi ku barwayi n'abakene b'amoko yose. Umurinzi w'ubutabera mu bantu.
Francis Xavier: Umwe mu Bayezuwiti ba mbere, yajanye Inkuru Nziza mu Buhinde, muri Aziya y'Amajepfo y'Iburasirazuba no mu Buyapani, abatiza ibihumbi n'ibihumbi. Umurinzi w'ubutumwa.
Francis de Sales: Umusenyeri wa Jenève akaba Umuhanga wa Ekleziya (1567–1622), wigishije ko umuntu wese ahamagarirwa ubutagatifu. Umurinzi w'abanditsi n'abanyamakuru.
Saint Joseph: Umugabo wa Bikira Mariya Mweranda n'umurezi wa Yezu, umuntu w'intungane warinze Umuryango Mweranda. Umurinzi wa Ekleziya yose, w'abavyeyi b'abagabo, w'abakozi n'urupfu rwiza.
Saint Patrick: Umusenyeri akaba Intumwa ya Irilande mu kinjana ca gatanu. Yajanywe muri Irilande ari umucakara akiri muto, agaruka ari umumisiyoneri maze azana ico kirwa mu kwemera.
Anthony of Padua: Umusaserdoti w'Umufransisikani akaba Umuhanga wa Ekleziya (1195–1231), umubwiriza ukomeye wakoze ibitangaza. Umurinzi w'abakene n'ibintu vyatakaye.
Francis of Assisi: Washinze Abafransisikani (1181–1226), wakiriye ubukene kugira ngo akurikire Kristu kandi wahawe ibikomere vya Umwami. Umurinzi w'Ubutaliyano n'inyamaswa.
John the Baptist: Integuza ya Umwami, wabwirije kwisubiraho, wabatije Yezu muri Yorudani kandi watanze ubuzima bwiwe ari umumaritiri ku bw'ukuri.
Michael (archangel): Umutware w'ingabo zo mu ijuru, urinda umuryango w'Imana imitego ya Sekibi. Umurinzi w'abasirikare, abapolisi n'abarwayi.
Raphael (archangel): Malayika mukuru wayoboye Tobiya kandi agakiza Tobiti; izina rye risobanura "Imana irakiza." Umurinzi w'abagenzi n'ugukira.
Gabriel: Malayika mukuru wamenyesheje Bikira Mariya ko azaba Nyina w'Umwana w'Imana. Umurinzi w'intumwa zitwara ubutumwa.
Saint Peter: Umutware w'Intumwa na Papa wa mbere, uwo Kristu yahaye imfunguzo z'Ingoma. Yiciwe i Roma ari umumaritiri kandi aruhukiye munsi ya Bazilika ya Mweranda Petero.
Paul the Apostle: Intumwa y'abanyamahanga, wahindutse ari mu nzira ija i Damasi. Ingendo ze n'amabaruwa ye vyakwije Inkuru Nziza mu isi yose y'Abaroma, yicirwa i Roma ari umumaritiri.
Saint Anne: Nyina wa Bikira Mariya Mweranda na nyirakuru wa Yezu, uhimbazwa hamwe na Mweranda Yowakimu. Umurinzi w'abavyeyi na ba nyogokuru.
Thérèse of Lisieux: Umubikira w'Umukarumelitakazi akaba Umuhanga wa Ekleziya (1873–1897), Akarabo Gato, wigishije "inzira nto" y'ukwiringira n'urukundo. Umurinzi w'ubutumwa.
Jude the Apostle: Intumwa akaba mwene wabo wa Umwami, umwanditsi w'Ibaruwa ya Yuda. Umurinzi w'ibibazo vyihebewe.
Vincent de Paul: Umusaserdoti w'Umufaransa (1581–1660) washinze Umuryango w'Ubutumwa n'Abakobwa b'Urukundo. Umurinzi w'ibikorwa vyose vy'urukundo.
Thomas Aquinas: Umusaserdoti w'Umudominikani akaba Umuhanga wa Ekleziya (1225–1274), umwanditsi wa Summa Theologiae. Umurinzi w'amashuri gatolika n'abanyeshuri.
Rita of Cascia: Umugore, umuvyeyi, umupfakazi n'umubikira w'Umwagustinikazi (1381–1457) wihanganiye imibabaro yihanganye cane. Umurinzi w'ibidashoboka.
Augustine of Hippo: Umusenyeri akaba Umuhanga wa Ekleziya (354–430), wahindutse ku bw'amasengesho ya nyina, Mweranda Monika. Umwanditsi w'Ivyo yiyemerera.
Saint Monica: Nyina wa Mweranda Agustini, wahawe ihinduka ry'umwana we abikesha imyaka myinshi y'amasengesho adacogora. Umurinzi w'abavyeyi n'abagore bubatse.
Saint Sebastian: Umusirikare w'Umuroma wiciwe ukwemera ku ngoma ya Diyokulesiyani ahagana mu 288. Umurinzi w'abasirikare n'abakinnyi.
Saint Lawrence: Umudiyakoni w'i Roma wiciwe ukwemera mu 258, werekanye abakene nk'ubutunzi nyabwo bwa Ekleziya. Umurinzi w'abadiyakoni n'abakene.
Saint Stephen: Umwe mu badiyakoni barindwi ba mbere n'umumaritiri wa mbere wa Ekleziya, wapfuye asabira abamuteraga amabuye.
Saint Nicholas: Umusenyeri wa Mira mu kinjana ca kane, wakundwaga kubera urukundo rwe n'impano yatangaga mu ibanga. Umurinzi w'abana n'abasare.
Saint George: Umusirikare n'umumaritiri wo mu ntangiriro z'ikinjana ca kane, urugero rw'ubutwari mu kwemera. Umurinzi w'abasirikare n'abaskuti.
James the Great: Intumwa akaba umuvandimwe wa Mweranda Yohani, uwa mbere mu Ntumwa cumi n'evyiri wapfuye ari umumaritiri. Ingoro ye i Santiago de Compostela ikurura abagenzi bo ku Camino. Umurinzi wa Esipanye.
Andrew the Apostle: Umuvandimwe wa Mweranda Petero n'Intumwa ya mbere yahamagawe, wazanye Petero kwa Yezu. Yiciwe ku musaraba i Patras. Umurinzi wa Ekose.
Martin of Tours: Umusirikare w'Umuroma wasangiye umwitero we n'umusabirizi, nyuma aba Umusenyeri wa Tours (yapfuye 397). Umurinzi w'abasirikare.
Benedict of Nursia: Umuvyeyi w'ubuzima bw'abihayimana mu Burengerazuba (ahagana 480–547), Amategeko ye y'isengesho n'umurimo yayoboye abamonaki mu binyejana vyinshi. Umurinzi w'Uburaya.
Saint Dominic: Washinze Umuryango w'Ababwiriza (1170–1221), wiyeguriye kwamamaza ukuri na Rozari.
Ignatius of Loyola: Umusirikare wabaye mweranda (1491–1556), washinze Umuryango wa Yezu kandi yandika Imyitozo ya Roho, vyose "ku bw'ikuzo risumvye ry'Imana."
Charles Borromeo: Arkiyepisikopi wa Milano (1538–1584) wavuguruye Ekleziya nyuma ya Konsili ya Trente kandi akita ku barwayi mu gihe c'icorezo.
Elizabeth Ann Seton: Umugore, umuvyeyi, umupfakazi n'uwayobotse ukwemera (1774–1821), washinze Ababikira b'Urukundo n'amashuri gatolika muri Amerika. Mweranda wa mbere wavukiye muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika.
Isidore the Laborer: Umukozi w'umurima w'i Madrid (yapfuye 1130), wari indahemuka mu Misa ya buri munsi kandi agira ubuntu ku bakene. Umurinzi w'abahinzi.
Saint Lucy: Isugi n'umumaritiri w'i Sirakuza (yapfuye 304), izina rye risobanura "urumuri." Umurinzi w'impumyi.
Saint Cecilia: Isugi n'umumaritiri w'i Roma waririmbiraga Imana mu mutima we. Umurinzi w'abaririmvyi n'umuziki mweranda.
Clare of Assisi: Umuyoboke wa Mweranda Fransisko (1194–1253) washinze Abaklarisi, wiyeguriye ubukene n'Isakramentu Ritagatifu.
Pope John Paul II: Papa kuva 1978 kugeza 2005, wavutse yitwa Karol Wojtyła muri Polonye, umugenzi utarambirwa wabwiye isi ati "ntimutinye." Yashyizwe mu beeranda mu 2014.
Pope Pius X: Papa kuva 1903 kugeza 1914 washishikarije guhazwa kenshi kandi akavyemerera abana bato, "kugira ngo vyose bivugururwe muri Kristu."
Luke the Evangelist: Umuganga akaba mugenzi wa Mweranda Pawulo, umwanditsi w'Inkuru Nziza ya Luka n'Ivyakozwe n'Intumwa. Umurinzi w'abaganga n'abanyabugeni.
Mark the Evangelist: Mugenzi wa Mweranda Petero akaba umwanditsi w'Inkuru Nziza ya Mariko. Umurinzi wa Venise.
Matthew the Apostle: Umusoresha Yezu yahamagaye ngo abe Intumwa, umwanditsi w'Inkuru Nziza ya mbere.
Bartholomew the Apostle: Umwe muri Cumi na Babiri, uwo Umwami yise "Umuyisraheli nyawe utagira uburyarya," wamamaje Inkuru Nziza kandi apfa ari umumaritiri.
Helena, mother of Constantine I: Umwamikazi akaba nyina wa Konstantini Mukuru, wabonye Umusaraba nyakuri mu rugendo rutagatifu rwe i Yeruzalemu.
Brigid of Kildare: Umukuru w'abihayimana b'i Kildare (yapfuye ahagana 525), wakundwaga kubera urukundo rwe no kwakira abashyitsi. Umurinzi wa Irilande.
Louis IX of France: Umwami w'Ubufaransa (1214–1270), umutegetsi w'intabera wiyeguriye isengesho n'abakene.
